description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Prismatic/NE magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1 + DEF/RES/MND -70%, Instant Cast, ATK/MAG/DEF/RES +30% & Quick Cast to party, Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: Support/Celerity/Black Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases allies' [Element] abilities with Quick ATB 1 & [Element] Ability Damage +30% for 1 turn to that ally (max 3 chases)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Quasar+: 1.2s CT; Ecliptic Howl+: 2500 heal
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
